compiled_state.title: S1.T5: Extend verify-session-provenance.sh grep to accept both DSO-Story: and DSO-Story-Merge: trailers + GREEN T4's test

compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: When this story is complete, the sub-PR merge trailer grammar is coordinated with `verify-session-provenance.sh:137` so commits landing via a reviewed sub-PR are recognized as provenanced at session→main time.

## Implementation Notes

Modify `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh` line 137 from:

```bash
if echo "$commit_body" | grep -q "^DSO-Story-Merge:"; then
```

to:

```bash
if echo "$commit_body" | grep -qE "^DSO-Story(-Merge)?:"; then
```

This makes the verifier accept BOTH trailer forms: `DSO-Story:` (written by `apply-attribution-trailers.sh` on task commits per CLAUDE.md story-branch invariant) AND `DSO-Story-Merge:` (written by `merge-story-branch.sh` in local mode per the existing contract). Both forms are valid provenance signals.

This is the LEAST-DISRUPTIVE coordination path: no changes to emitters (apply-attribution-trailers.sh, merge-story-branch.sh remain untouched), only the READER is extended. The contract doc `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/dso-story-merge-trailer.md` will be updated by S_docs to reflect the new acceptance grammar.

After implementation, T4's test must pass (GREEN). Remove the RED marker from `.test-index`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh` | modify | `tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh` | needs-modification (RED test in T4) |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (remove RED marker) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] verify-session-provenance.sh accepts both trailer forms (regex updated)
  Verify: grep -qE 'DSO-Story\(-Merge\)\?' plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh
- [ ] T4's RED test now passes (GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh
- [ ] `.test-index` no longer carries the verify-session-provenance trailer-coordination RED marker
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_verify_session_provenance_accepts_both_trailers\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Existing tests for verify-session-provenance.sh still pass (no regression)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh

## Retry Budget

On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
